The heavens of Ashan bleed, and ancient covenants are put to the test. As hellfire pierces the mortal world, even the most beautiful song can become a harbinger of the apocalypse.

🟢 Support the channel and help me create better content: https://www.youtube.com/@AethernalPictures/join

I present to you the second chapter of the series inspired by the cult game Heroes of Might and Magic 5. In this episode, the portal is opened, and demonic legions set out for conquest, bringing destruction even where peace had prevailed until now.

You will see here my interpretation of Inferno's dark power. The whole thing was created using advanced artificial intelligence tools to give the world of Heroes V the cinematic scale it has always deserved.

⚔️ Haven't seen the first part? Catch up here: https://youtu.be/0w41NN3gsjk

If you're a fan of HoMM5 and want to see how this story unfolds – leave a subscription and a thumbs up! Your support allows me to develop this saga.

Do you think Sylvan can stop this Breath of the Abyss? Let me know in the comments!
